provenance: Official operation documentation and the pinned s3s 0.17.0 Bucket/ListBuckets DTO documentation; no live AWS capture.

wire_cases.no_options: Complete result; no continuation, Prefix or BucketRegion
wire_cases.any_option: Paginated; omitted max-buckets defaults to 10000; explicit range 1 through 10000
wire_cases.prefix_presence: Echo supplied prefix, including an empty prefix
wire_cases.continuation: ContinuationToken only when more matching buckets remain; no IsTruncated
wire_cases.region: Must match the regional endpoint; local mismatch uses InvalidArgument
wire_cases.owner: Canonical ID; no synthetic display name

local_choices: No AWS account quota is imposed on the local unpaginated operation.
Tokens are operation/store/filter-bound and are not AWS tokens.
Native calls always use bounded pages, defaulting to 1000.
Unpaginated HTTP owns linear metadata/XML buffers and releases SQL before network writes.
